description:

 Location: Mumbai Mulund – Corporate Office
 Reporting To: Managing Director
 Team: 1 Junior Costing Executive
 Our Industry: Food processing
 Salary: 15–20 LPA, depending on experience and capability Qualification CMA / ICWA Qualified – Mandatory CMA Inter candidates will not be considered Experience 10+ years total experience Minimum 7 years post-CMA qualification Relevant experience in Costing / Commercial Finance / Management Accounting Manufacturing industry experience is mandatory Export costing / commercial finance experience preferred About the Company Sunrise Naturals Private Limited is an established fruit processing and export company with over 25 years of industry experience and customers across 60+ countries. The company is engaged in fruit procurement, processing, packing and export of fruit pulps, purees and concentrates, with manufacturing operations in Tamil Nadu and corporate operations in Mumbai. Role Overview The Costing Manager / Head of Costing will independently own the complete costing and profitability function. The role will work directly with the Managing Director and will be responsible for product costing, pricing analysis, export costing, inventory profitability, variance analysis, budgeting and management MIS. The candidate must be able to independently build complete costing models from a blank Excel workbook without depending on pre-built templates or systems. Key Responsibilities Own end-to-end product costing from raw fruit procurement through processing, packing and dispatch. Prepare product-wise, pack-wise and batch-wise costing sheets. Develop dynamic costing models based on raw material prices, yield, conversion costs, packing, freight, forex and financing costs. Prepare export price calculations for Ex-Works, FOB, CIF and CFR. Maintain pricing and costing assumptions and compare standard costing with actual execution. Analyse raw material cost, yield, conversion cost, packing cost, logistics, labour and overhead variances. description:

The Regional Service Manager coordinates with service teams, optimizes resource allocation, and implements strategies to enhance service delivery, ultimately contributing to the company's overall financial and operational goals.

Manage the allocation of service engineers and tools, ensuring optimal use of resources. Track and analyze service performance metrics, implementing improvements where necessary. Ensure all service operations comply with company policies, industry standards, and safety regulations. Key Account Management Build and maintain strong relationships with key accounts, acting as the primary point of contact. Develop and implement tailored service plans for key accounts, ensuring their specific needs are met. Oversee the negotiation, renewal, and execution of service contracts for key accounts. Regularly assess and enhance customer satisfaction through feedback and surveys. Service Revenue Management Develop strategies to meet and exceed regional service revenue targets. Work with the sales and finance teams to set competitive and profitable pricing for services. Identify and implement opportunities for additional revenue generation through upselling, cross-selling, and new service offerings. Monitor and report on service revenue performance, providing insights and recommendations for improvement. ICT and Timely Maintenance Develop and oversee the execution of preventive maintenance schedules for customer equipment. Ensure the effective use of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) systems to support service operations and maintenance tasks. Monitor the timeliness of service deliveries, ensuring maintenance tasks are completed within agreed timelines. Maintain accurate records of all service and maintenance activities, using ICT systems to track and report on performance. Breakdown Management and Technical Solutions Lead the response to equipment breakdowns, ensuring quick and efficient resolution to minimize downtime. Provide technical guidance to service engineers in diagnosing and resolving complex issues. Drive initiatives to increase the first-time fix rate, reducing the need for follow-up visits. Keep customers informed of the status and resolution of their issues, ensuring transparency and satisfaction.

o Serve as the primary point of contact for high-value clients, ensuring their needs are met and
expectations exceeded.

offerings.
o Develop account strategies to drive business growth and ensure profitability.
o Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to create tailored proposals for clients.
 3. Strategic Planning & Execution 
o Develop and implement customer relationship strategies that align with the organizations objectives.
o Monitor client metrics and KPIs, including satisfaction scores, retention rates, and revenue.

development, marketing, sales, and support efforts

o Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams, including product, sales, and customer support, to
deliver seamless client experiences.
o Act as a client advocate during organizational decision-making processes.

o Oversee the customer support function to ensure prompt and effective resolution of customer inquiries,
issues, and concerns.
o Implement service level agreements (SLAs) and performance metrics to monitor and improve the quality
of customer support.
o Develop training programs and resources to empower support teams to deliver exceptional service.
 6. Data Analytics, Reporting & Documentation 
o Maintain accurate records of client interactions, contracts, and other relevant details in CRM tools.
o Translate data-driven insights into actionable strategies for enhancing the customer experience
o Prepare and present reports on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer satisfaction,
revenue forecasts, retention, and loyalty programs to senior leadership.

12+ years of experience in customer relationship management, account management, or a similar role, with at least 7+ years in a senior and team handling position is must.
Client facing and having experience in devising strategies for Key Accounts, Large Accounts, Government Accounts.

Leadership and mentoring capabilities.
Strong Analytical Skills to interpret data and derive actionable insights.
Effective Communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and present ideas clearly.
Proven experience in Sales and expertise in Market Segmentation to strategize customer engagement and retention.
Project Management skills for implementing CRM projects and streamlining processes.
Experience with CRM platforms like Salesforce and understanding of customer lifecycle management is a plus.
Ability to adapt to dynamic work environments and meet organizational objectives.
Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

title: Closing Manager
description:
Hiring: Closing Manager Location: Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
 Salary: 50,000 60,000 per month
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Experience: 3–6 years in Sales / Closing / Business Development
 Department: Sales About the Role We are looking for a highly driven and experienced Closing Manager who can take qualified leads through the final stages of the sales process and consistently convert opportunities into revenue. The ideal candidate should have strong sales closing ability, negotiation skills, communication skills, commercial understanding, and team-handling capabilities . The person must be comfortable speaking professionally and confidently in English, Hindi, and Marathi . This is a target-driven role requiring someone who can take ownership of the complete closing process, identify customer requirements, overcome objections, negotiate effectively, and ensure successful conversions. Key Responsibilities Sales & Closing Handle qualified and high-intent leads and convert them into successful sales. Own the sales process from the final discussion/demo/site visit through negotiation and closure. Understand customer requirements, pain points, budget, and decision-making process. Build urgency and move prospects toward a buying decision without compromising customer experience. Conduct effective follow-ups through calls, WhatsApp, email, and meetings. Negotiate pricing, commercial terms, and other objections within company-approved guidelines. Identify decision-makers and influencers and ensure all relevant stakeholders are engaged. Maintain a healthy and accurate sales pipeline. Consistently achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets. Minimize lead leakage and ensure timely follow-up on every qualified opportunity. Customer Handling & Negotiation Develop strong relationships with prospects and customers. Handle objections related to pricing, competition, timing, product/service value, and decision-making. Clearly communicate the value proposition and differentiate the company's offering from competitors. Understand customer buying signals and identify the right time to close. Maintain professionalism while dealing with difficult, hesitant, or demanding customers. Ensure a smooth handover to the operations/customer-success team after closure. Pipeline & CRM Management Maintain accurate records of all prospects, conversations, follow-ups, and closures in the CRM. Keep the sales pipeline updated with correct stages, expected closure dates, deal values, and next actions. Prepare daily/weekly/monthly sales reports. Track conversion rates, follow-up performance, lost opportunities, and reasons for non-conversion. Ensure there are no unattended or ageing high-intent leads. Team Coordination & Leadership Coordinate closely with lead-generation, pre-sales, marketing, operations, and management teams. Guide junior sales executives/closers on objection handling, negotiation, follow-ups, and closing techniques. Review team pipelines and help identify deals that require intervention. Conduct regular performance reviews and sales huddles when required. Share market feedback, customer objections, competitor information, and sales insights with management. Take ownership of team-level revenue targets if assigned. Required Skills & Competencies Excellent spoken and written English Fluent Hindi Fluent Marathi Strong verbal communication and presentation skills Excellent negotiation and persuasion abilities Strong objection-handling skills Proven ability to close high-value or complex deals Strong follow-up discipline Excellent relationship-building skills Ability to understand customer psychology and buying behaviour Strong commercial and business understanding Target-oriented and highly accountable Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills Good numerical and analytical ability Professional phone etiquette Strong interpersonal skills Ability to work independently as well as lead/coordinate a team Good knowledge of CRM systems, MS Excel/Google Sheets, WhatsApp, email, and sales reporting tools What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate should: Have a proven track record of achieving sales targets . Be a confident closer rather than someone focused only on lead generation. Be comfortable making frequent follow-up calls and handling negotiations. Know how to identify genuine prospects versus low-intent leads. Be persistent without being aggressive or unprofessional. Have strong ownership of numbers and revenue. Be comfortable discussing pricing and commercial terms with customers. Have excellent listening skills and the ability to understand the real reason behind a customer's hesitation. Be able to handle multiple deals simultaneously without losing track of follow-ups. Have a strong sense of urgency and accountability. Be willing to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment. Maintain accurate CRM and sales records. Demonstrate maturity, professionalism, and integrity while dealing with customers and internal teams. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will primarily be measured on: Monthly revenue/booking target achievement Number and value of successful closures Lead-to-sale conversion rate Qualified-lead-to-closure conversion Average deal value Follow-up efficiency Sales pipeline value and accuracy Closure turnaround time Revenue generated per month Customer experience and post-sale handover quality Team performance, where applicable Experience & Qualification Education: Bachelor's degree in any discipline preferred. Experience: 3–6 years of relevant experience in sales, business development, inside sales, real estate sales, financial services, B2B/B2C sales, or another target-driven sales environment. Prior experience in a dedicated closing role will be preferred. Experience handling negotiations and high-value customers will be an advantage. Prior team-handling experience will be an added advantage. Language Requirement Mandatory: English — Excellent Hindi — Fluent Marathi — Fluent The candidate should be comfortable conducting customer conversations, negotiations, presentations, and follow-ups in all three languages. Compensation 50,000 – 60,000 per month Additional performance-based incentives/variable pay may be provided based on the company's compensation structure and achievement of targets. Work Location Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra Why Join Us? Performance-driven work environment Opportunity to handle meaningful sales responsibility Career growth based on performance Exposure to high-value customer interactions and negotiations Incentive opportunities linked to performance Opportunity to grow into a senior sales/leadership position

title: Digital Customer Service Manager
description:
Job Description: Digital Customer Service Manager - Asset Management
 
 Role Summary 
The Digital Customer Service Manager is responsible for managing and enhancing digital investor servicing experiences across online and assisteddigital channels for an Asset Management Company (AMC). The role focuses on investor satisfaction, service quality, digital adoption, regulatory compliance , and close coordination with operations, technology, RTA, and distributor ecosystems.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Digital Investor Service Operations 
 Own endtoend digital servicing for investors and distributors across: AMC website and investor portals Mobile applications Email, chat, chatbots, and digital service requests Ensure timely resolution of investor queries related to: Transactions (purchase, redemption, SIP, SWP, STP) Account statements, capital gain statements KYC, FATCA, nomination, bank mandate changes Monitor and manage service SLAs, TATs, and quality standards. Ensure consistency of service across digital and assisted channels (contact center, branches, RTAs). 
 2. Investor Experience & Journey Optimization 
 Design, monitor, and continuously improve digital investor journeys across the investment lifecycle. Identify common investor pain points, repeat service requests, and digital dropoffs. Drive initiatives to: Increase selfservice adoption Reduce manual and assisted requests Improve ease of investing and servicing digitally Track and improve investor satisfaction metrics such as NPS, CSAT, and complaint ratios. 
 3. Digital Platforms, Automation & RTA Coordination 
 Work closely with: Call center Team Internal digital and IT teams RTAs (e.g. CAMS) Technology and service vendors Define business and service requirements for: Digital service enhancements Chatbots, automation, and workflow tools Participate in UAT, releases, and postdeployment monitoring for digital changes. Ensure seamless integration and handoffs between AMC systems and RTA platforms. 
 4. Complaint, Escalation & Regulatory Management 
 Oversee handling of digital servicerelated complaints and escalations. Ensure timely and compliant resolution of: Investor grievances SEBI SCORESrelated complaints Senior management and ombudsman escalations Drive root cause analysis (RCA) and preventive actions for repeat issues. Ensure transparent communication with stakeholders and investors where required. 
 5. Regulatory Compliance & Governance (Asset Management Focus) 
 Ensure adherence to SEBI, AMFI, and internal AMC guidelines for investor servicing. Ensure compliance with: Investor grievance redressal timelines Digital communication and disclosures Data privacy, cybersecurity, and access controls Maintain SOPs, service documentation, and auditready records. Support internal audits, regulatory inspections, and RTA reviews. 
 6. Performance Monitoring & Reporting 
 Track and analyze key digital service and investor experience metrics: Digital service volumes vs assisted Complaint ratios and resolution trends Turnaround times and SLA adherence Channelwise adoption and usage Publish MIS dashboards and insights for senior management. Recommend service and experience improvements based on data and trends. 
 7. Stakeholder & Distributor Ecosystem Management 
 Act as a key liaison between: Call center team Digital & IT teams Operations & call centers RTAs Compliance & risk teams Distributor service teams Support distributor digital enablement and service experience where applicable. Ensure vendors and partners meet service quality and regulatory expectations. 
 Required Skills & Competencies 
 Core Skills 
 Strong experience in investor servicing or customer operations within Asset Management Deep understanding of mutual fund transactions, investor lifecycle, and RTA processes Experience managing digital service channels and service platforms Strong complaint and escalation handling skills Digital & Analytics 
 Familiarity with: Digital platforms, mobile/web servicing journeys CRM, ticketing systems, chat tools Automation and workflow solutions Ability to interpret service data and derive actionable insights Behavioral & Leadership Skills 
 Investorcentric mindset with strong service ethics Excellent communication and stakeholder management Detailoriented with strong compliance awareness Ability to manage multiple priorities in a regulated environment 
 Qualifications & Experience 
 Bachelors degree in Business, Finance, Technology, or related field (MBA preferred). 610 years of experience in customer service, digital operations, or CX roles within Asset Management / Mutual Funds . Handson experience working with RTAs and digital investor platforms. Certifications in CX, Digital, Service Management, or Mutual Fund operations are an advantage. 
 Reporting & Interfaces 
 Reports to: VP Digital Investment Solutions Key Interfaces: Digital & IT Teams, RTA, Operations, Compliance, Call Center, Vendors

title: Credit Controller
description:
Job Summary 
 Roastea is hiring a Credit Controller for its Vending Vertical to manage accounts receivable and ensure timely collections. The role plays a key part in maintaining healthy cash flow, controlling credit exposure, and coordinating with internal teams to resolve billing and payment-related matters. This position requires strong follow-up skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple Client accounts efficiently. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Manage end-to-end accounts receivable for the vending business. Ensure timely and accurate invoicing as per agreed commercial terms. Monitor aging reports and follow up on outstanding payments. Conduct client visits for payment follow-ups, reconciliations, and issue resolution. Travel locally as required to meet clients for collections and account discussions. Maintain accurate client ledger reconciliations and resolve discrepancies. Coordinate with Sales and Operations teams for billing or service-related disputes. Monitor credit limits and highlight potential risk accounts. Negotiate payment schedules where required. Drive timely collections and work towards reducing overdue balances. Prepare periodic reports on collections and receivables status. Every Month Invoice submission to the clients as per the communicated time line. 
 Requirements 
 Bachelors degree in Finance, Accounting, or Commerce. 3to6 years of experience in credit control or accounts receivable. Experience in FMCG, beverage, vending, or B2B service industry preferred. Strong knowledge of accounting systems and MS Excel. Good negotiation and communication skills (Kannada and English). Strong attention to detail and analytical ability. Ability to manage multiple accounts and meet collection targets.

Senior Customer Experience Manager
description:
What is this role all about?
 



 As a
 **Senior Customer Experience Manager** 
 , you will own the
 **technical success, customer experience, and long\-term growth** 
 of a portfolio of enterprise accounts on the Kapture platform. You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to drive successful implementations, platform adoption, integrations, and value realization.
 



 You will act as a trusted advisor to customers while leading internal teams across Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales to deliver solutions that address customer business needs. The role combines
 **customer relationship management, project and delivery ownership, technical solutioning, and business value realization** 
 .
 



  





 What will you do in this role?
 


* **Own enterprise customer success:** 
 Take end\-to\-end ownership of customer health, adoption, technical success, and long\-term account growth.
* **Lead and develop the team:** 
 Monitor team performance, provide coaching and feedback, build accountability, and ensure consistent delivery standards.
* **Build strategic customer relationships:** 
 Establish trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders, manage multiple stakeholders, and drive a structured operating cadence.
* **Drive implementations \& change requests:** 
 Own the delivery of new implementations, enhancements, and change requests in close collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.
* **Drive adoption \& value realization:** 
 Identify opportunities to improve product adoption, platform utilization, customer experience, and measurable business outcomes.
* **Lead technical solutioning:** 
 Understand customer requirements and translate them into scalable solutions, guiding internal teams on feasibility, approach, integrations, and implementation.
* **Manage complex integrations:** 
 Work with APIs, JSON, webhooks, databases, CRM integrations, and other enterprise systems to ensure seamless platform adoption.
* **Own critical escalations:** 
 Lead complex technical and customer escalations, drive root\-cause identification, coordinate resolution across teams, and ensure timely communication to stakeholders.
* **Drive stakeholder communication:** 
 Provide regular updates on implementation progress, risks, dependencies, escalations, and business outcomes to customer and internal stakeholders.
* **Partner cross\-functionally:** 
 Work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support to represent the customer's voice and drive timely resolution of customer requirements.
* **Identify growth opportunities:** 
 Understand customer business priorities and identify opportunities for deeper adoption, additional use cases, and account expansion.



  





 What does success look like in this role?
 



 Success in this role means delivering exceptional customer experiences while driving measurable business outcomes. You consistently ensure customers adopt the platform effectively, resolve technical challenges efficiently, build executive relationships, improve customer health, and identify opportunities for expansion. Your ability to combine technical expertise with business consulting helps customers maximize the value of Kapture's platform while contributing to retention and revenue growth.
 



  





 What would make you a good fit for this role?
 



 Basic Requirements
 


* 5–7 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, Solution Consulting, or Enterprise SaaS.
* Experience managing enterprise customers across both business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, onboarding, adoption, retention, and stakeholder management.
* Experience working with APIs, integrations, troubleshooting, and enterprise SaaS implementations.
* Ability to manage multiple customer engagements while collaborating effectively with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams.



  





 What are the most critical skills for this role?
 


* Strong customer\-first mindset with ownership of customer outcomes and business success.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for customers.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with experience debugging integrations and resolving technical issues.
* Familiarity with monitoring and debugging tools such as Kafka, Grafana, Sentry, or similar platforms.
* Strong commercial awareness with the ability to identify adoption gaps, customer risks, and account growth opportunities.
* Excellent cross\-functional collaboration skills across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams.

title: Senior Customer Experience Executive
description:
1. Role Purpose The Senior Customer Experience Executive will be responsible for delivering a high-quality customer experience while providing effective sales and after-sales support. The role requires strong product knowledge, customer understanding, communication, problem-solving and cross-functional coordination to ensure customers receive accurate information and timely resolution. The ideal candidate should understand the product portfolio in depth, confidently guide customers based on their requirements, handle product-related queries independently and take complete ownership of customer cases through to closure. 2. Product Knowledge & Customer Advisory Develop and maintain strong knowledge of the company's complete product portfolio, including features, specifications, applications, benefits, pricing, warranty and service policies. Understand product differences and recommend the most suitable product based on customer requirements. Confidently explain product features, benefits, usage and limitations to customers. Handle product-related customer queries independently wherever possible. Continuously update product knowledge when new products, features or policies are introduced. Identify gaps in customer understanding and provide clear, accurate product guidance. 3. Customer Experience Handle customer enquiries, complaints and requests through phone, email, WhatsApp and other approved communication channels. Provide accurate, professional and solution-oriented responses with a strong focus on customer satisfaction. Take complete ownership of customer cases from initiation to closure. Proactively follow up on pending cases rather than waiting for the customer to contact the company again. Handle difficult customers and escalations with maturity, empathy and professionalism. 4. Sales Support Support the Sales team with customer enquiries, product information, order-related requirements and follow-ups. Provide Sales with accurate product information and customer insights whenever required. Coordinate with Sales and relevant internal functions to ensure customer requirements are fulfilled. Follow up on customer requirements and ensure timely closure. Maintain accurate records of enquiries, customer requests, follow-ups and pending actions. 5. Complaint & Issue Resolution Understand the customer's actual concern and identify the appropriate resolution. Use product knowledge to distinguish between product-related, usage-related, service-related and process-related issues. Coordinate internally for resolution while retaining ownership of the customer case. Track escalated cases and ensure timely closure. Identify recurring customer or product issues and highlight them to management with practical recommendations. 6. After-Sales Support Handle product usage, warranty, replacement, service and other post-sales queries. Explain applicable policies and processes clearly to customers. Coordinate with relevant teams for service, replacement or other approved resolutions. Keep customers informed throughout the resolution process. Ensure all customer commitments are properly documented and followed up. 7. Customer Records, MIS & Reporting Maintain accurate and updated customer records and interaction history. Ensure enquiries, complaints, follow-ups and customer interactions are properly documented. Prepare regular reports on customer enquiries, pending cases, complaints, resolution status, sales-support activities and escalations. Monitor ageing cases and highlight matters requiring management intervention. Identify trends in customer queries and complaints and support continuous improvement. 8. Internal Coordination Work closely with Sales, QC, Operations, Dispatch, Warehouse, Accounts and other relevant functions to address customer requirements. Ensure clear communication between customers and internal teams. Follow up proactively rather than waiting for other departments to provide updates. Maintain professional working relationships across functions. Candidate Profile Graduate in any discipline. A degree or diploma in Business Administration, Sales, Customer Service or a related field is an advantage. Relevant experience in Customer Care, Customer Experience, Sales Coordination, Sales Support or a similar customer-facing role. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Strong product-learning ability and confidence in explaining products to customers. Good customer-handling, follow-up and coordination skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities. Working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, email and CRM/ERP or other business systems. Ability to maintain trackers and prepare basic MIS. Role & responsibilities
